title: Signal from the retention policy feature added to Application Insights telemetry for partners

en.title: Signal from the retention policy feature added to Application Insights telemetry for partners
en.summary: If a telemetry key for an environment has been specified in the Business Central administration center or in the app.json file, the server will emit telemetry about retention policy events.
en.details:
### Feature details

The Business Central server will emit telemetry about retention policy events, such as: A table was added to the list of allowed tables. The first retention policy was enabled. The last retention policy was enabled. Data was deleted. Partners and customers can use this data to monitor their environments on the usage of the retention policy feature.

### See also

Monitoring and Analyzing Telemetry (docs)
